description: baseline LSTM (32 hidden, lr 1e-4), hit 1800s time budget at epoch 1625/20000
PHYSICAL (symmetric friction, euler, lr 1e-4, long_window_prob 0.15); python-loop epochs too slow (only 375/20000 in budget), best_epoch=0, no real training occurred
PHYSICAL (symmetric friction, euler, lr 1e-3, long_window_prob 0.0); higher lr let friction/mass params actually move, clear improvement over run01 and run02
PHYSICAL_ASYM (asymmetric friction, euler, lr 1e-3, crops_per_step 1); more epochs (650) but extra friction params didn't help, slightly worse than run03
HYBRID (PHYSICAL backbone, symmetric friction, + 16-unit LSTM residual, lr 1e-3, crops_per_step 1); best so far, residual correction helps on top of physics
HYBRID + asymmetric_friction True; fewer epochs (575 vs 875), worse than run05, asymmetric backbone + residual compete for limited steps
LTC (closed-form continuous-time cell, 32 hidden, lr 1e-3, crops_per_step 1); massive jump over all previous families, test RMSE near paper's closed-loop simulation quality
LTC with 64 hidden / [64,64] f_net (vs run07's 32/[32,32]); slightly worse, bigger capacity didn't help at this step budget
LTC with tau_max 2.0->5.0 (wired new config knob into build_model_from_config); essentially a tie with run07, marginally worse val RMSE
LTC with lr 1e-3->5e-4 (tried to reduce eval-to-eval noise); noise persisted, worse than run07
LTC with crops_per_step 1->2 (average 2 windows/step for lower gradient variance); halved epoch count (475 vs 975), noise persisted, worse than run07

NEW: HYBRID with LTC residual (added residual_type="LSTM"/"LTC" option to HybridEMPSModel, physical backbone + ClosedFormCTC residual instead of LSTM residual); worse than pure LTC (run07), fewer epochs (500 vs 975) from the extra physical forward pass per step
LTC with direct_feedthrough True; close but still slightly worse than run07, test RMSE also slightly worse

LTC with weight_decay 0.0->1e-5; val RMSE close to run07 but at an early best_epoch (400) with much worse test RMSE, val/test diverge -- sign of the noisy eval landscape rather than a real improvement
LTC with dropout_prob 0.0->0.05; worse than run07 on both val and test RMSE, dropout noise adds to rather than tames the instability
